reference_tables: Table 1/3 AUROC; Table 5/6 AP; Table 4 size; Table 16 valid nodes
implementation_status: 2026-10-13 audit found edge-policy and AMEN scaling errors. Historical runs are retained; corrected protocol runs are separate. Running a suite does not establish reproduction of paper metrics.
seed_note: Five repetitions follow Section 4.3. These seed values and fixed SVD seed are local choices, not published author seeds.

datasets.name: Cora
datasets.data_note: FreeGAD/AlignGAD copies have identical SHA-256 and match Table 16 (0 isolated, 475 degree-one, 2233 valid). 5802 injected edges still differ from Table 4's 5429; author input hash is unpublished. Historical CoLA copy had 2239 valid nodes.

datasets.name: YelpChi
datasets.data_note: FreeGAD MAT copy; reported paper edges are undirected, stored adjacency has both orientations.

datasets.name: Reddit
datasets.data_note: FreeGAD MAT copy; retain stored row-neighbor direction, record actual degree statistics.

datasets.name: T-Finance
datasets.data_note: BWGNN original ZIP, optional DGL/torch required; temporary extraction at run time; one-hot labels decoded. Author NeighborDiv graph preprocessing is not fully specified.

datasets.name: Tolokers
datasets.data_note: Incoming stored-edge neighbors reproduce all Table 16 degree counts (930 isolated, 975 degree-one, 9853 valid). This is an inference from topology, not a published author loader. Yandex's bidirected loader differs.

datasets.name: Disney
datasets.data_note: Symmetric union matches Table 16 (0 isolated, 11 degree-one, 113 valid) and reproduces main AUROC/AP to four decimals. Historical preserve policy was a local error.

datasets.name: Questions
datasets.data_note: Incoming stored-edge neighbors reproduce all Table 16 degree counts (17603 isolated, 17751 degree-one, 13567 valid). Inferred topology does not resolve the AUROC/AP gap; author feature/preprocessing details remain unknown.
